title: A Kannadagowla in Rupakam
description: A meditation on this wistful ragam was on order today.
artist_note: The cold of the morning was just beginning to break when we sat down to record. As the air warmed, so did we but it lead to a nice build up in vibes.
location: By the couch, near the fireplace

title: A Kedaragowla *slowly approaching* ('mandakranta')
artist_note: Inspired by listening to a serenely musical family collectively render three different, carefully crafted (and remembered) songs in this raga.

title: Fiery Todi
artist_note: The mridangam's toppi really opened up in this one. I'm happy with it. Gautam's really bringing it in this one and I keep coming back to it for one more play.

title: A Sweet Asaveri
artist_note: During the week prior to this, an instrumentalist rendered - for the sake of a small handful of mridangam students - a song in this raga, with its 'curved' ('vakra') prayogas (passages) - and, spontaneously singing kalpana swaras ('dream notes') thereafter (startling everyone a bit...) led to attempting to think through the raga on the fly here.

title: Eventually Elevated Hamsanadam
artist_note: *Swan sound*, this raga name would have it, programmatically...

title: Hamsanandi, hang on...
artist_note: *Swan bliss*, this raga name would have it, programmatically. I suppose I can imagine a swan blissfully singing this (with an effort...)

title: Kambhoji Prelude ( ... to what?)
artist_note: This session occurred in the midst of the preparations for an unexpected gathering.

title: Meandering Khamas
artist_note: Tried some slow/fast transitions that didn't work completely.

title: Every Emotion Navarasakannada
artist_note: The kids were playing around, creating a pillow fort while we recorded which clearly added to the presentation of this ragam.

title: Simple Suddhadhanyasi
artist_note: A fancy name for a very common 'scale' - the so-called *minor pentatonic*, here approached quite straightforwardly.

title: Reliving the past (in fives)
description: A playful and joyful ragam that just leant itself to a cycle of fives (or tens) AKA kanda chapu.
artist_note: There was a 'tautness' to this session that we'll want to dive into more and more
